question: How is the goddess remembered in relation to all ritual acts?
premises: Many forms or instances are remembered.
This remembrance applies in all rites.
inference: She is remembered in many ways as the giver of many siddhis in all rites.
uncertainties: The exact referent of bahava (forms, names, or traditions) is not explicit.
plain_english: As the giver of many siddhis, she is remembered in many ways in all rites.
